label: organization based or located in
definition: Organization X is based, headquartered or physically located in geographic place Y.
scope_notes: Explicit headquarters, campus, office and based-in evidence qualify. Company/firm modified by a city may express location. Nationality-only adjectives are ambiguous; corporate-family and Internet-sector membership, events and personal activity alone do not qualify.

facts.reason: Apple is explicitly based in Cupertino, with headquarters and campus there.
Bell identifies the corporate family or breakup in these rows, not a geographic location of BellSouth.
Internet describes the research sector and subject of reports, not a geographic place where Forrester Research is based.
The explicit firm-based-in and firm-in paths locate the Hicks organization in Dallas. Ownership and interview paths are mixed additional evidence.
Jupiter Communications is classified as an Internet firm and analyst of Internet trends; these do not locate it geographically.
